title: Vegan Croatian Tagine with Pear
description: A hearty, flavorful vegan stew originating from Croatia, made with a tagine and featuring sweet pear. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pear and zesty vinegar, and stir to combine.
Season with Croatian paprika and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
